deploy-bot: CANARY ALERT: error_rate(5m)=6.2% (baseline 0.8%), p95 latency +210ms, deploy=release/v3.8.0-canary
Emily H.: saw it, thanks. which route is hit most?
Kevin L.: looks like /api/generate for small batch jobs (traffic slice 12%). logs show timeout->retry cascade.
Sarah M.: can we roll back just the canary slice? prefer manual partial revert vs full pin.
Kevin L.: agree. I propose: 1) pause new canary traffic 2) revert canary pool to v3.7.1 3) keep rollforward disabled until postmortem.
Michael R.: dedicated customers on that pool? any stateful changes that break back-compat?
Emily H.: no DB migrations in v3.8.0, model weights only. revert is safe. Dedicated EU pool is not on this canary slice.
Sarah M.: runbook command: ``/deploy rollback --pool canary --to v3.7.1 --reason "canary error spike"`` (ops playbook section 4.2).
Kevin L.: I'll take the rollback. putting a human lock on auto-rollouts: ``/deploy lock auto-rollout --reason canary-spike``
Ops-Bot: AUTO-ROLLBACK POLICY: threshold exceeded but human override required. Lock applied by @Kevin L..
Emily H.: who will notify customers and internal stakeholders? I'll draft a short blurb for #status and #customer-impact.
Michael R.: ops postmortem owner? I can pair with Emily on the initial triage and collect relevant traces.
Sarah M.: after revert, let's run a 30m observation window, check p95 and error_rate <1% across slices. If stable, we can re-run the canary with the model flag off and A/B tests.
Kevin L.: executing: 4812349999 -> running ``/deploy rollback --pool canary --to v3.7.1`` now. ETA ~2m. tagging @Emily H., @Michael R. :eyes:
deploy-bot: ROLLBACK STARTED: job_id=rb-20260321-01, started_by=Kevin L., targets=canary-pool
Emily H.: drafting status msg: "Incident: Canaries for v3.8.0 showed elevated errors, rollback to v3.7.1 initiated for canary pool. No dedicated customers affected. Monitoring..." Agree?
Michael R.: yep, add link to runbook and include timeline when available.
deploy-bot: ROLLBACK COMPLETE: job_id=rb-20260321-01, status=success, completed_in=95s, new_active_version=v3.7.1
Kevin L.: observation window started. setting alert suppression for noisy retries for 30m.
Sarah M.: great. follow-up actions: create rollback postmortem, hold re-release until root cause identified, consider canary traffic reduction by 50% next attempt.
Emily H.: I'll post to #status and ping sales for any flagged accounts. finishing blurb now. :thumbsup:
Kevin L.: thumbs. reopening rollout only after PR with fix + e2e passes and a canary rerun with 2x longer observation.
Ops-Bot: INCIDENT LOGGED: incident/2026-03-21-canary-spike, assignees=[Kevin L., Emily H., Michael R.], priority=high
Emily H.: thanks everyone. moving to postmortem channel in 30m.
